basic_details.job_title: IIT Dharwad Counselling Psychologist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad (IIT Dharwad) is filling 1 post of Counselling Psychologist on contract for its Medical/Health/Wellness Services work. Pay is a consolidated remuneration of up to ₹ 60,000 per month (inclusive of all), for an initial period of one year. The essential qualification is a Master's degree in psychology/counselling psychology/clinical psychology from a recognised University, with at least one year of relevant counselling experience. Eligible Indian Citizens must apply only online at www.iitdh.ac.in by 4 December 2026, up to 23:59 Hrs.

Give a correct and active email ID in the application. Call letters and all other information are sent by email.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Dharwad
content_sections.text: IIT Dharwad is described in the notice as an Institute of National Importance established by an Act of Parliament in 2016. Its address is Chikkamalligawad, Dharwad, Karnataka – 580 011. The Institute is looking for experienced staff who can contribute significantly to its Medical/Health/Wellness Services related work, and this post is on contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Citizens may apply. Eligibility in terms of age, qualification and experience is considered as on the last date of application. The qualification must be from a recognised University/Institute. Master's degree in psychology/counselling psychology/clinical psychology from a recognised University. Registration with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) or the National Healthcare Professionals Registry (HPR) under the National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. At least one year of relevant post-qualification experience in counselling, preferably in a higher educational institution, residential institution, counselling center or mental health establishment. Experience of counselling in the age group of 18 to 30 years, preferably in a residential institution or in any counselling Centre or Psychiatric Clinic, administering and interpreting psychometric tests. Membership of professional societies. The age limit printed in the notice is 65 years. No minimum age and no age relaxation is printed in the notice. The essential qualification and experience are a bare minimum. Meeting them does not entitle an applicant to be called for test(s) and/or Personal Interview. Candidates should consult the official notification for the exact eligibility wording.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is based on skill sets, experience and competency, up to ₹ 60,000 per month (inclusive of all). The contract engagement is initially for one year. It may be renewed subject to satisfactory performance, the requirement of the Institute and approval of the Competent Authority. On extension, a 3% increase in salary may be considered. The post is purely contractual. After the contract period, the candidate has no right to further extension, regularization or permanency at the Institute. The selected applicant must make his/her own arrangements for housing outside the campus.

content_sections.heading: IIT Dharwad Counselling Psychologist [on contract] Job Description
content_sections.text: The role and responsibilities, which "include, but are not limited to", are: One-on-one Psychological Counselling of the students and emergency intervention. Group Therapy Counselling. Psychological Testing. Awareness workshops and events. Psychological literacy enhancing campaigns.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Dharwad Counselling Psychologist [on contract]
content_sections.text: Apply ONLY through the online process. The application form and detailed instructions are on the IIT Dharwad website at the staff recruitment page. Give a correct and active email ID in the application. Call letters and all other information are sent by email. Upload the supporting certificates and documents listed below. Pay the application fee of ₹ 200/- (Rupees Two hundred only), including GST, through the State Bank e-pay link available in the online application. After payment and submission, a confirmation email is sent to the registered email ID. Do not send a hard copy of the online application form; the notice says it is NOT required. The last date for submission of the online application is 4 December 2026 up to 23:59 Hrs. Applicants must keep a copy of the completed application. All details in the online application are treated as final and no changes are entertained. Original scanned copies of certificate(s), document(s) and mark sheets of all semesters/years, in support of the claim on qualification (matriculation onwards), experience, date of birth, caste, category and so on. Proof of pay drawn at the time of retirement or a copy of the PPO, wherever applicable. Experience certificate on the organisation's letter head, bearing the date of issue, specific period of work, nature of duty, designation and pay drawn for each position, duly certified by the issuing authority. Original certificates and self-attested copies must be produced at the time of the selection process as well as while joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection procedure is Test/Presentation/Interview/Any other mode as decided by the Institute (or) Selection Committee. The notice does not give a test or interview date. Where many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of applicants called for test(s) and/or Personal Interview to a reasonable limit. This is done on the basis of Academic Performance and/or Qualification and/or Experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Applicants should therefore give details of all qualifications and experience in the relevant field, beyond the minimum if any, with documentary evidence. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process. No interim correspondence is entertained about the conduct and result of tests or the reasons for not being called for test(s)/Interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Counselling Psychologist posts is IIT Dharwad filling?

faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 4 December 2026, up to 23:59 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Dharwad Counselling Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's degree in psychology/counselling psychology/clinical psychology from a recognised University, plus at least one year of relevant post-qualification experience in counselling.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice prints the age limit as 65 years. Age is considered as on the last date of application.

faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is up to ₹ 60,000 per month (inclusive of all), based on skill sets, experience and competency.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 200/- including GST, payable through the State Bank e-pay facility linked in the online application. It is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply ONLY online through the form on the IIT Dharwad staff recruitment page. A hard copy of the online application form is not required to be sent.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by Test/Presentation/Interview/Any other mode as decided by the Institute (or) Selection Committee. The Institute may limit the number of applicants called on the basis of academic performance, qualification or experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract, initially for one year, which may be renewed. After the contract period there is no right to extension, regularization or permanency.
